name: FRONT DESK
blurb: Intake forms, PINs, the fake smile. Profile lives here.

name: STREET MAP
blurb: A corkboard of alleys. Unlocks the Run tab so you can actually go outside.

name: THERAPY COUCH
blurb: Stained. Expensive. This is the CBT Tree, billed as growth.

name: WARDROBE CAGE
blurb: Headbands, polos, a cape that is not a license.

name: TROPHY CABINET
blurb: Awards you have to claim. Growth is not automatic. Neither is Gold.

name: MAIL SLOT
blurb: The Session Log. Gifts, threats, invoices from the therapist.

name: BULLETIN BOARD
blurb: Daily coping goals. Check a box. Open a chest. Call it progress.

name: COMPARE MIRRORS
blurb: Build Compare. Split-screen menus only. Nobody splits the street.

name: BLOOD FRIDGE
blurb: Between-run snacks. Gold goes in. Bandages come out. Science.

name: CAMP SHOP
blurb: Build it. Then the wheel, the slots, the chests. Upgrade expands stock.

name: QUICK PATROL
blurb: 2×/day. Idle gold and XP while the game is closed and while you play.

name: RESEARCH CENTER
blurb: Silencers, mags, hollow feelings. Parts in, caliber out.

name: MARTIAL ARTS SCHOOL
blurb: Learn moves. Master ranks. Shaolin badges. The Son already teaches this.

name: WORKSHOP
blurb: Parts, coils, thread, ink. Gear and clothes are one build.

name: BOUNTY BOARD
blurb: Street contracts. Claim is required. The radio will lie about who hired you.

name: THERAPY RADIO
blurb: Mayor Raven on a loop. Daily VO. Heat makes him smugger.

name: FAMILY ALBUM
blurb: Polaroids instead of just gold. Pin the night. The fridge still wants a copy.

name: STREAK LOCKER
blurb: Consecutive files. Chests on a rail. Die and the clipboard laughs.

name: INVOICE LOTTERY
blurb: Two gems. One spin. Civic engagement, billed as luck.

name: PUNCHING BAG
blurb: Eight seconds. Light the dummy. Combo toaster. The dojo still wants tuition.

name: WARRANT FAX
blurb: Once a day. Fax a complaint. Gold comes back. Tape packs itself. Civic engagement.

name: TIP JAR
blurb: Five gold. Toss it. Gem, snack, or the jar eats it. Civic engagement, billed as luck.

name: LOST AND FOUND
blurb: Once a day. Pack a pipe into the next spawn. SoR4 left bats in barrels.

name: PAYPHONE
blurb: Once a day. Dial City Hall. Eight gold and Mayor Raven. The cord is sticky.
